data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for downloading images from URL or bytes to the user's device on Flutter Web.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter web developers to easily trigger downloads of images directly from a URL or from a UInt8List to the user's local machine. Supports optional image quality adjustments and custom HTTP headers.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web application and need to save images locally.
You need to download images directly from a URL or raw bytes (UInt8List).
You require custom HTTP headers when fetching the image to download.
avoid_when: You need to download images on mobile platforms (iOS/Android) rather than Flutter Web.
You are looking for general file downloading beyond images.
strengths: Simple static API for quick integration.
Supports downloading from both URLs and byte arrays.
Allows custom headers and image quality configuration.
